body:
Parent: #1715
Depends on: #1707, #1709, #1710, #1712, #1713, #1769

## 原子目标

从当前生产comment/moderation模型、canonical author mode、policy/reason/signal/evidence registries与测试消费者生成唯一closed/versioned状态inventory、capability catalog与postcondition schema。本issue只建立合同和validators，不创建comments、不写DB/cache/queue、不实现producer或删除legacy fixtures。

## 必须交付

1. Inventory machine-readable覆盖：actor modes、moderation statuses/reasons、version/edit states、soft-delete states、thread/depth limits、region compliance states、signal/evidence states、queue visibility rules与public/admin projection rules。
2. Actor modes exact引用#1769current runtime values：`public`与`zk_anonymous`；禁止legacy aliases、`anonymous`、`pseudonymous`、`identified-opt-in`、`current-equivalent`或demo-derived values。
3. Capability catalog至少完整表达父issue所列root/reply/nested/depth/edited/deleted/moderation matrices/actor capabilities，并为每项声明owner、required article/auth refs、state fields、postconditions与proof tests。
4. Thread关系schema closed表达comment/root/parent/reply_to/depth、article/actor identity、current version/history、delete/public placeholder语义。
5. Moderation schema closed表达status/reason/timestamps/region/signal/evidence/queue/public visibility与current policy/catalog digests。
6. Public/admin read-model/cache expectations逐status machine-readable，不以`queue count > 0`或当前demo行为定义。
7. 互斥states必须要求独立semantic identities；不得允许single comment sequential mutation作为fixture authority。
8. Deprecated/unknown status/reason/actor/signal/evidence从inventory拒绝，不能因旧demo/DB值继续保留compat。
9. Inventory/catalog/schema/version digests进入producer plan/receipt/cleanup identity；变化使旧fixtures失效。
10. Validator拒绝missing/duplicate/orphan capability、unknown state、wide wildcard、unowned postcondition、legacy actor、second state map与tamper。

## 固定约束

- 不创建或修改comments/moderation数据。
- 不实现thread/version/delete ports，归#2159。
- 不实现moderation/region/signal/queue ports，归#2160。
- 不实现producer/legacy removal。
- 不修改#1794。

## 必须测试

- legacy actor accepted；
- missing rejected/spam/delete/version/depth states；
- queue visibility unspecified；
- region/signal/evidence text-only label；
- same comment allowed all mutually exclusive states；
- queue count postcondition；
- demo state defines contract；
- unknown/deprecated aliases；
- duplicate/orphan capability；
- second status/actor map；
- schema/catalog digest tamper；
- article/auth refs missing owner。

## 验收条件

- [ ] Comment/moderation/actor/thread/evidence inventory唯一、closed、versioned、完整。
- [ ] Actor modes只使用current canonical values，无legacy aliases。
- [ ] 每capability拥有精确relations/postconditions/public-admin visibility。
- [ ] Unknown/deprecated/duplicate/unowned全部fail closed。
- [ ] 本PR不创建数据或实现producer。

## 非目标

- 不实现comment lifecycle ports。
- 不实现moderation/evidence ports。
- 不生成fixture receipt。
- 不删除legacy demo/helpers。
title: feat(test-fixtures): 定义 comment actor、thread、moderation 与 evidence state inventory
